segments.name: Agentic Commerce
segments.description: AI platform that unifies discovery, conversation, checkout, fulfillment, payments and service for retail merchants and enterprises, delivered through Brain Commerce and Brain Checkout.
segments.evidence: Rezolve's flagship product, Brain Commerce, powered by our proprietary large language model ("LLM") brainpowa, transforms the online shopping experience.

revenueModel.text: Retail merchants and enterprises pay monthly subscription, consumption and usage-based fees for cloud-based SaaS commerce software and professional IT services.
revenueModel.evidence: Merchants are billed on a monthly basis for the services rendered.
